direction: Natural light, one familiar kitchen, ordinary surfaces. Dish frames are cropped to show the pan and food.
common: One original 3:2 landscape still for a naturalistic interactive Shanghai drama. Same fictional Wu and same actual-feeling old Shanghai breakfast shop as provided reference, now running a small evening service in Xinzhuang, actual neutral steel, used cooking tools, ordinary light bulbs, tactile fabrics, soft city dusk, realistic Chinese food. Think documentary still at 40mm, natural colors. Let one gesture or prop carry the image. No glamour light, logos, rendered surfaces, staged advertising, text, decorative menus, readable words, dramatic artificial steam, or over-polished look. Keep primary details within central 70% of image for crops.

items.counter: Opening frame. Wu in black apron behind two simple cast-iron griddles at the open street counter. He is holding up two ordinary narrow blank-looking order slips, ready to pass them to the unseen adult player. Behind him, a small neighborhood line and silhouettes of a parked bicycle in cool natural evening light. Frame from the player's side of the counter, actor face and raised slips legible.
items.sheng: Close side angle of real Shanghai shengjian buns on a flat seasoned iron griddle, rounded little white flour buns with pleated tops, dark sesame and chives scattered, several show their evenly toasted golden bottoms as a plain metal spatula lifts an edge. Soft light, honest oil shine and actual kitchen textures, food sharply readable. Nothing else in focus.
items.guo: Close view of real Shanghai guotie potstickers in the second shallow cast iron pan, long crescent ridged shape and pan-fried toasted flat edges, a bare stainless spatula off to one side, warm ordinary light. Cropped at cooking height. No garnish except a little flour. Make dish look distinctly different from round buns.
items.rush: Counter from inside the narrow shop, during actual evening service. Two well-used black griddles, pale clipped little slips, a few hands waiting for their takeout across the counter at different heights, no full faces required. One visible hand sorting pale order slips. A dark-blue city dusk and practical bulbs. Calm frame conveying how much there is to do.
items.close: Late evening with Wu behind the same counter, apron dusty. He has just set down a small plate of well-browned shengjian and is looking to one side at an unseen cook with a weary satisfied smile. Old notebook and ordinary light fixture; some empty stools in the actual street outside.
items.burnt: After the rush. A worn black pan holding a couple of round buns with realistic overdone dark brown edges and a damp cloth on stainless counter. Wu's sleeve and hands in far half of frame, one adult with metal spatula starting to scrape. Shop still feels warm and lived-in, actual oven residue, no flames or smoke clouds, quietly funny.

empty: One photorealistic close photo for a Shanghai game kitchen, landscape 3:2. Close angle from slightly above: a single empty dark iron flat griddle with faint seasoning marks, just wiped, at an ordinary Xinzhuang street-front dumpling stall. The shot is entirely the iron cooking surface and the edge of a stained stainless steel counter, and one oil brush near a far edge. Believable real materials, warm practical bulb and a little cool dusk spill. No people, food, labels, overly glossy surfaces, lighting effects or illustration. Tight detail. The supplied earlier service photo is for the shop's real material palette only.
